articles.title: GEEKOM Returns to CES 2026 with Premium Laptops and Next-Generation Mini PCs
articles.mainIdea: GEEKOM Returns to CES 2026 with Premium Laptops and Next-Generation Mini PCs
articles.summary: PR Newswire: GEEKOM Returns to CES 2026 with Premium Laptops and Next-Generation Mini PCs. GEEKOM will make its fourth consecutive appearance at CES 2026, taking place from January 6 to 9 at Booth 35025 in LVCC South Hall 2. As a leader in the Mini PC industry, GEEKOM is presenting its most focused product launch to date, marking a major expansion into premium laptops while continuing to advance its compact computing lineup.
